title: Why you instantly recognise a familiar face
hook: Ever wonder why faces are so easy to remember?

narration.text: You can instantly recognise thousands of faces, even after years.
This amazing skill comes from specialised brain areas.
These areas rapidly process unique facial features and expressions.
They build a unique mental library for every person you know.
Some people have prosopagnosia, or face blindness.
For them, faces seem unfamiliar, even those of close family.
It shows how crucial these dedicated brain regions are.
How many faces do you think you could recognise?

description: Your brain has dedicated areas for facial recognition, allowing you to instantly identify familiar faces. Learn how this process works and what happens in conditions like prosopagnosia, or face blindness.
topic: Why you can instantly recognise a familiar face, explaining prosopagnosia and facial recognition areas.
